note.text: Real — the HUSKY / Covered CT dental plan brand, administered by the BeneCare ASO under contract with Connecticut DSS. CTDHP handles the provider network, Plan-Net directory, referral coordination, member services, and prior-authorization / post-procedure review intake — it is NOT the claims payer. Dental claims (837D) are adjudicated and paid by Gainwell (the DSS fiscal agent). There is no dental MCO in the HUSKY model.
